answer_text:
The volume of an \(n\)-dimensional ball of radius \(r\) is proportional to \(r^n\). For a 100-dimensional ball,

\[
V_{100}(r)=C r^{100}
\]

for some constant \(C\). The fraction of the volume within 40 miles of the surface is the shell between radii \(4000-40=3960\) and \(4000\):

\[
\frac{V(4000)-V(3960)}{V(4000)}
=
\frac{C(4000)^{100}-C(3960)^{100}}{C(4000)^{100}}
=
1-\left(\frac{3960}{4000}\right)^{100}.
\]

Simplify:

\[
1-\left(\frac{99}{100}\right)^{100}
=
1-(0.99)^{100}.
\]

Since

\[
(0.99)^{100}\approx 0.3660323413,
\]

the desired fraction is

\[
1-0.3660323413 \approx 0.6339676587.
\]

Thus, the fraction is

\[
\boxed{1-\left(\frac{99}{100}\right)^{100}\approx 0.634}
\]
